digest.component_or_area: core reconciler dispatch — outbound transport capability guarding
propositions: Four call sites in the reconciler cast to capability Protocols but do not runtime-guard the capability before invoking optional members, leaving the check static-only with no runtime effect.
Missing capabilities cause silent failures: AttributeError lands in a broad exception handler and the mutation is never applied, making the pass report success when capability is absent.
The distinction between designed skip (capability absent by design) and real failure (capability present but raised) is not observable, violating the separation needed for a multi-backend system.
Capability detection must use isinstance against @runtime_checkable Protocols with a hasattr fallback to handle proxying transports and Python version differences in runtime_checkable semantics.

A capability-absent skip must be logged as INFO with an alert record on the bridge_alerts channel under a distinct kind, counted as a computed operation but not applied, so it remains queryable and detectable.
